text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Farmers sowed over only four-fifths of the 1996 crop area because of dry weather in 1997.
- King Hassan II's adviser Andre Azoulay says Morocco's economic priority is to create jobs.
- Moroccan businessmen visit Saudi Arabia and Qatar to boost exports to the two countries.
- World Bank lends Morocco $85 million to upgrade its railway network.
- More than 62 percent of Moroccan women in rural areas are illiterate.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali meets human rights officials to discuss the human rights situation in Morocco.
